decision: A credit is a workspace child. A credit line is the child of a credits section
why: A recording has one parent. The reusable credit cannot also sit under every kit. The line stores the role and credit_recording_id. Name and URL stay on the credit.
Active Record reserves default_role for the database connection. The screen already says Usual role.

decision: Credits.add! copies usual_role only when the new line role is blank
why: The kit role is the line's. Later edits to the credit must not rewrite lines that already exist.

decision: Trashing a credit leaves its lines. Public and preview skip a trashed credit. The editor says In the trash
why: Hiding the line would lose the kit role. Deleting the credit would break the id the line stores. Restore shows the line again.
Press kit indexes already list active records only. Restore stays on Trashable's trash bin.

decision: Credit lines reuse QuoteOrder with a CreditLine type
why: The section list already posts recording_id and before_recording_id. A second order class would duplicate that.

decision: Credit API has no destroy. The line payload reads name and url from the credit
why: Destroy would drop the id existing lines store. The kit section payload stays title, subtitle, content_type, content_id.

decision: Credits is a secondary button on the press kit index
why: The workspace list is not a new app. The section type is the kit menu item.

decision: Gem tests passed. Dummy tests passed after the usual_role rename and the seed helpers moved under the admin user
why: default_role raised DangerousAttributeError. The seed lambdas could not see user. The editor still lists a removed credit in the picker, so the assertion checks the line list and the preview.
result: 80 gem, 99 dummy, 33 declarations, 2 quote payload, 2 credit payload, 0 failures

decision: Drove Studio Workspace in Chrome through the credit list, a kit role, a new credit, removal, and the public page
why: Tailwind and Flatpack stylesheets loaded. Tom's usual role stayed Photographer while the kit line became Photography + Film. Jane Smith left the kit and stayed on the workspace list.
result: public page shows Project credits through Vitra, no Jane

decision: Count Tom Ross on the test workspace, not in the whole table
why: CI sets DATABASE_URL, so db:prepare seeds the same database the tests use. A second Tom Ross from the dummy seed made the global count 2.
result: credits tests passed after seeding the test database

decision: Add credit is its own screen. The section page keeps the list
why: A search and a role on the section form looked like fields for every credit. The role belongs to the credit being added. Choosing one reveals Role on this kit, starting from the usual role.

decision: The credits section uses Flatpack's collection editor
why: The first column searches workspace credits and can create one in a modal. Role on this kit is the line. Save stores the rows. Dragging a saved row sends moving_recording_id and a 1-based target_position.

decision: A saved credit reorder updates the preview column
why: The reorder request returns JSON and stays on the page. The preview is server-rendered, so it kept the previous order until Save. list:saved moves the preview lines to match the rows.

decision: Choosing a credit, editing the role, and removing a row update the preview before Save
why: Those edits stay in the form until Save reloads the page. The preview kept the last saved lines. The same controller adds, rewrites, and removes preview lines from the row.

decision: Save sits under the credit table and turns primary only when the rows change
why: A primary bar above the table looked like the next step before anyone edited a line. Flatpack's unsaved-changes button stays default until the form differs from the saved lines.
